en: Dependent on a limited state … [and so on] … dependent on a sublime state … [and so on] … dependent on an immeasurable state … (Abbreviated. Under the root condition there are thirty-two; under the object condition, twenty-seven;

under the predominance condition, twenty-seven … [and so on] … under the mutuality condition, thirty … [and so on] … under the prenascence and repetition conditions, twenty-four … [and so on] … under the non-disappearance condition, thirty-two.
